question:
Refer to the given series and answer the question that follows. All numbers are single digit numbers only. Counting to be done from left to right.

(Left) 3 2 5 4 6 2 5 3 9 7 4 5 1 1 1 5 2 3 3 8 8 4 4 6 3 1 6 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 3 2 5 4 6 2 5 3 9 7 4 5 1 1 1 5 2 3 3 8 8 4 4 6 3 1 6 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Even — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94ca0c5c42f5c8a152a0b77838a0a5bf335696b95ad94a415b9433a3e71955c5.png] 

Thus, there are 3 even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
